desc: Join this machine to a Tailscale or Headscale network, and advertise subnet routes and exit node
authLink: Open this link to authenticate the device
notConnected: Not connected to the tailnet yet
notEnabledHint: Not enabled. Fill in the settings below, turn on "Enable" and save.
authKeyPlaceholder: tskey-auth-… (leave empty to authenticate via login link)
hostnamePlaceholder: Leave empty to use the system hostname
loginServerPlaceholder: Leave empty for official Tailscale; for Headscale enter https://hs.example.com
routesHelp: Share these subnets with other devices in the tailnet; approval in the admin console is required
exitNodeHelp: Allow other devices to access the internet through this machine
acceptRoutesHelp: Use subnet routes advertised by other devices
manageDaemonHelp: When off, uses the tailscaled already running on the system and only runs tailscale up
userspaceHelp: Needs no TUN device or privileges; recommended in containers
socks5Placeholder: e.g. localhost:1055; leave empty to disable
socks5Help: With userspace networking, local programs reach tailnet devices through this proxy
socks5Public: This proxy has no authentication. When it listens on a non-local address, any device that can reach that address can use it to enter the network; listening on 127.0.0.1 only is recommended
wgPortHelp: 0 picks one automatically; once fixed, open this UDP port in your firewall to allow direct connections
daemonArgsPlaceholder: Appended to the tailscaled command line, e.g. --verbose=1
envPlaceholder: One KEY=VALUE per line, e.g. TS_DEBUG_FIREWALL_MODE=nftables
envHelp: When the host iptables uses the nf_tables backend, set TS_DEBUG_FIREWALL_MODE=nftables; otherwise subnet forwarding rules end up in a different table set
socketPlaceholder: Leave empty for the system default, e.g. /var/run/tailscale/tailscaled.sock
